nodes.klein: to pursue, chase; to persecute. he pursued, chased; he persecuted, harassed; he followed eagerly; it flowed rapidly. was pursued, was chased; was persecuted; was oppressed; was synonymous. he pursued ardently, drove away; he strove eagerly to reach. was pursued, was driven away (in the Bible occurring only Is. 17:13). was scattered, was dispersed. he pursued, chased (in the Bible occurring only Jud. 20:43). was pursued, was chased (in the Bible occurring only in the part.; see מֻרֽדֶּף).
